profile.research_note:
Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 45 (CyrusOne missing-address campaign): matched this rows CME branded name to a dedicated Baxtel listing and a corroborating datacentermap CHI1 listing agreeing on the same street address, further corroborated by SEC filing language.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] CyrusOne is a large scale data center provider headquartered in Dallas, Texas. In 2016 CyrusOne purchased the Chicago Mercantile Exchanges original Aurora, Illinois data center from CME Group for roughly 130 million dollars, with CME Group continuing to operate its Globex matching engine on site under a 15 year lease. In November 2021, KKR and Global Infrastructure Partners agreed to acquire CyrusOne in an approximately 15 billion dollar deal, taking the company private, and that acquisition closed in 2022. CyrusOne has operated as a privately held company since, a company level ownership fact this registry had not previously recorded with a citable source. This specific row, Chicago Aurora CME, is this operators original Aurora, Illinois facility, purchased from CME Group in 2016 as described above. A Baxtel listing dedicated to this exact facility name, fetched fresh this session, gives 2905 Diehl Road, Aurora, Illinois as the street address, corroborated by a separate datacentermap listing for this operators CHI1 building at the same address, and further corroborated by an SEC filing that independently refers to this facility as the Chicago-Aurora I data center.
sources_tried: A Baxtel listing dedicated to the exact CME branded facility name giving a street address, corroborated by an independent datacentermap listing for the CHI1 building at the same address and an SEC filing referring to a Chicago-Aurora I data center
